name: lucene
title: Lucene
description: Perform inserts or queries against Apache Lucene databases.
label: database,search

properties.name: host
properties.description: The URL to the lucene server

properties.name: operation
properties.description: Operation to do such as insert or query.

properties.name: analyzer
properties.description: An Analyzer builds TokenStreams, which analyze text. It thus represents a policy for extracting index terms from text. The value for analyzer can be any class that extends the abstract class org.apache.lucene.analysis.Analyzer. Lucene also offers a rich set of analyzers out of the box

properties.name: indexDir
properties.description: A file system directory in which index files are created upon analysis of the document by the specified analyzer

properties.name: maxHits
properties.description: An integer value that limits the result set of the search operation

properties.name: srcDir
properties.description: An optional directory containing files to be used to be analyzed and added to the index at producer startup.

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.
